mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic recovery gains momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of triggered instances, or the correlation between UNRATE decline and returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a near-zero interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), the market reacts positively to the sustained low rate by pushing S&P 500 returns higher over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 (INDPRO < 95) signals a deepening economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances, or the correlation between INDPRO < 95 and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates stronger economic fundamentals, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profitability expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods with rising GDPC1, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a weak consumer demand regime (RSAFS < 300,000), a rise in retail sales above 300,000 signals improving consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity picks up.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of triggered instances, or the correlation between RSAFS crossing 300,000 and positive returns is not significant (p > 0.05).
